source.book: 据《史记》卷六十一《伯夷列传》改编。
source.excerpt: 伯夷、叔齊，孤竹君之二子也。父欲立叔齊，及父卒，叔齊讓伯夷。伯夷曰：「父命也。」遂逃去。叔齊亦不肯立而逃之。國人立其中子。

imageReview.originalPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Make ONE finished Histree vintage Chinese lianhuanhua atlas for《伯夷叔齐相让》. EXACTLY 4 equal landscape illustrations, STRICT TWO columns × 2 rows. Read left to right, top to bottom. Target 1024×660. Straight thin cream gutters 6px, no outer margin/header/footer, no merged cells or insets. NO TEXT anywhere: no Chinese, letters, numerals, captions, labels, calligraphy, speech bubbles, watermarks. Documents must be blank.
The supplied image is ONLY a STYLE reference: match early Shanghai animation / classic 1950s Chinese small-picture books, expressive stylized ADULT folk-art people with angular eyebrows and noses, larger heads, compact adult bodies, spare fluid BLACK ink lines, FLAT matte indigo/ochre/cinnabar/green blocks, subtle paper grain and warm cream negative space. Simple geometric buildings and restrained landscapes. No realistic skin modeling, brocade detail, modern anime, 3D or glossy shading. Do NOT copy the reference's story, props, characters or lettering.
Character continuity and physical invariants: 伯夷年长成年瘦脸灰蓝袍短须，叔齐年轻成年青绿袍；父亲不在场，国人拥立的中子为赭袍成年男子。四格无争斗、无王冠转赠。
Illustrate these events EXACTLY in order. The following Chinese describes scenes, NEVER render the text:
1. 孤竹君原想让小儿子叔齐继位，后来父亲去世。
2. 叔齐不肯受位，要把君位让给兄长伯夷。
3. 伯夷说这是父亲的命令，自己逃离。叔齐也不肯继位，离开了。
4. 国人最终拥立了中间的儿子。
